implementation_summary: Added src/lib/calculatorInput.mjs with MapleStory-based equipment/job candidates and level normalization helpers.
Updated src/pages/index.astro to render the first calculator input step: required item level stepper, equipment select, and checked-by-default job checkboxes.
Kept calculation formulas, scroll selection, and result computation out of scope.

failing_first.result: failed before implementation because src/lib/calculatorInput.mjs and calculator controls were missing

behavior_mapping: nextItemLevel clamps level decreases at 0 and increments by 5.
equipmentKinds includes MapleStory equipment candidates including 모자, 상의, 하의, 장갑, 신발, 망토, 무기.
jobKinds includes MapleStory job families including 전사, 마법사, 궁수, 도적, 해적.
index.astro renders -5/+5 controls, min=0 numeric input, and checked job checkboxes from the shared list.
